title: agropyron caninum subsp. latiglume
intro: Agropyron caninum subsp. latiglume, commonly known as blue wild rye, is a type of plant in the Poaceae family, native to North America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of blue wild rye include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and possess hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
